subject: Post-demo: Novaline usage profile & $/1M sanity check
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@novaline.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novaline.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: Novaline usage profile & $/1M sanity check

Thanks Claire / Daniel — nice demo earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can produce an estimate that maps to your runway: 

Summary from call:
- Primary integration: user-facing summarization + conversational support (production in Q1).
- Nominal expected tokens: 30M / month during steady state.
- Campaign months (marketing + feature launch): up to ~80M tokens in a month (windowed over 2–3 days).
- 99th percentile peak TPS observed in your traffic sketch: ~320 TPS; worst-case short burst you called out ~450 TPS for <15 minutes.
- Latency target: <250ms token latency preferred but not blocking for launch.

Asks for confirmation (so our pricing and capacity notes are accurate):
1) Can you confirm whether 30M is the best estimate for a committed monthly baseline vs a purely on-demand model?
2) For campaign bursts, do you expect sustained 300–450 TPS for multiple hours or short spikes (~10–30 minutes)?
3) Target $/1M tokens range that would work for Novaline (ballpark is fine) — we typically see customers target $6–$14 depending on commitment and SLAs.

Attached: a short mutual action plan (MPA) + a sample invoice template (CSV) and the traffic profile workbook we filled in during the call.

If you confirm the three bullets above, I’ll pull together a hosted API proposal (banded pricing + burst add-on) and a baseline SLA option for Q1.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: novaline-mrp.xlsx (XLSX), redwood-mpa-v1.pdf (PDF), sample-invoice-Redwood.csv (CSV)

From: Claire Huang <claire@novaline.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Novaline usage profile & $/1M sanity check

Thanks Soojin — great summary, that matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Commitment: we are comfortable committing to a 36M token/month baseline for Q1 (we need that for forecasts). We will evaluate increasing to 50M in Q2.
2) Campaign bursts: typical marketing campaign causes a 2–6 hour sustained period where TPS averages ~300 TPS and spikes to ~450 TPS for a few minutes. The campaign pattern is infrequent (2–4x per quarter).
3) Budget cadence: our procurement team is targeting a blended spend that maps to $8–$12 / 1M tokens, depending on SLA and support. If you have tiering that reduces unit price with a committed baseline, that would be ideal.

Security/compliance note: we will need SOC2 evidence and a short data residency statement for EU customers (we operate a small EU cluster). Can you include that in the proposal?

Next step: please send a hosted API pricing estimate with a burst option and an outline of latency SLOs. Procurement wants a two-option quote: (A) 36M committed + burst credits, (B) 50M committed (discounted).

—Claire
Claire Huang
Head of Product, Novaline
claire@novaline.ai | +1 (646) 555-0821

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire@novaline.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novaline.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T18:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Novaline usage profile & $/1M sanity check

Appreciate the quick clarity, Claire — this is exactly what we need. Action plan and what we’ll include in the formal quote: 

- Option A (36M committed / month): unit price preview = $11 / 1M tokens. Includes 20% burst credit pool (usable for campaign minutes) and a 3% monthly overage rate on top of committed slabs. 99th percentile token throughput SLO: support up to 350 TPS with automated scaled burst up to 450 TPS (subject to capacity and short-notice limits).
- Option B (50M committed / month): unit price preview = $9.25 / 1M tokens. Larger burst pool (30%) and priority routing (lower cold-starts and higher concurrency guarantees).
- Hosted API assumptions: standard data handling (no private deployment). For EU residency we can route EU customers to our eu-1 region (add-on) and provide SOC2 Type II report and our data processing addendum.

Attachments: I’ve attached an MPA with the two-option pricing sketch and a sample invoice. I will also open a HubSpot deal and attach the quote formally.

Next steps: 
- I’ll draft the two-option quote and aim to send by end of day tomorrow.
- Karthik, can you confirm the pricing flexibility above and whether we can commit to the 50M price band for a signed 6-month table-stakes SLA? If there’s any margin pressure I can scope in a ramp schedule.

Thanks —
Soojin
